issues.issue: Ciorbă de perișoare is a concrete familiar Romanian soup. Independent original recipes from2010and2014 establish enduring household recognition. Meat and lovage are ingredients; rice is a common optional meatball ingredient, explicitly included by one author and discussed but omitted by Jamila. Chiftele is an association between minced-meat preparations, not a claim that fried patties are added to soup. Five real incoming neighbors give hot feedback; ordinary mâncare/ciorbă/supă approaches are useful. No new factual claim requires one universal recipe. Sources: https://www.barbatlacratita.ro/2010/10/ciorba-de-perisoare.html ; https://jamilacuisine.ro/ciorba-de-perisoare-reteta-video/

The two shortest routes connect meatball soup to stuffed cabbage through rice or meat. Both ingredients are independently documented in original recipes for the canonical dishes. Rice in meatballs is explicitly a variant; no pan-Romanian regional association or universal vegetarian/meat claim is made. Distinct endpoints and two ingredient choices form a legible food bridge. The new precise captions preserve those distinctions. Sources: https://www.barbatlacratita.ro/2010/10/ciorba-de-perisoare.html ; https://jamilacuisine.ro/sarmale-pas-cu-pas-reteta-video/
